citation.source: USDA Food Buying Guide for Child Nutrition Programs, grains crediting methodology: 16 grams of creditable grain ingredient = 1.0 oz eq, for baked, flour-based grain products ('Groups A-G' in the FBG's grain item groupings).
citation.note: Confirmed against multiple CACFP/state-agency crediting handbooks that cite this FBG figure, not the primary FBG PDF table directly.

contribution.note: The 16g rate applies specifically to Groups A-G (bread-type baked goods, e.g. this repo's own simple_flatbread.json). A different rate (28g per oz eq) applies to cereal/grain-based-dessert Groups H-I — not modeled here, since this entity (flour) is only ever baked into a Group A-G product in this repo's current recipes.
